metadata.title: Hypervelocity binary stars: smoking gun of massive binary black holes

notes: No identifiable star meets either eligibility category. Hypervelocity stars are discussed only as a population, without individual star identifiers. Scorpius X-1 (T:p4-b10) is described as a bound binary that may have been ejected from the Galactic center, not as a Galactic unbound candidate or a follow-up to one.
